fact: On 19 May 2026 the Ministry of Finance handed IT kits (Starlink, computers, printers, solar panels) to the 23 provincial-capital communes under the World Bank-supported PATN, to digitalise information, revenues and expenditure; no revenue system is named.
title: Ministère des finances : Des kits informatiques aux communes chefs-lieux des provinces
publisher: Agence Tchadienne de Presse et d’Édition
